fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (KRW 1,404,000) has declined 57% from its June high, exceeding the historical down-cycle average of 51%, though IM Securities has issued a buy recommendation with a target price of KRW 2.3 million.
fields.summary_ko.1: HBM revenue is expected to increase from KRW 43 trillion this year to KRW 183 trillion in 2028, with expanded cHBM share reducing profit volatility, and a target price based on 2028 BPS could rise to KRW 3.6 million.
fields.summary_ko.2: A plan to return 50% of free cash flow after 2028 (70% through share buybacks) could achieve a 2x EPS scenario by 2030 if share count declines 50%.
